rows.grounds: name or qualifier of the field

items.question: Which specific field is enjoined to be avoided by this ritual instruction?
premises: The verse identifies a field by name.
The field is designated as Śṛṅgāṭaka and Kardina.
The verb prescribes avoidance of that field.
items.inference: The field named Śṛṅgāṭaka Kardina must be avoided.
uncertainties: The precise identification or location of the field named Śṛṅgāṭaka Kardina is unclear.
items.plain_english: One should indeed avoid the field named Śṛṅgāṭaka Kardina.
